name: Womb
overview: Scripture reveals that God is intimately involved in the formation of life from the womb, as He is the Creator who fashions each person even before birth (Job 31:15; Isaiah 44:2, 24). The womb is depicted as a sacred place where God’s protective and purposeful work takes place (Psalms 139:13; Psalms 22:9). Children are described as a precious heritage and reward from the Lord, emphasizing the divine value and blessing of life formed in the womb (Psalms 127:3). This teaching underscores God's sovereignty and care in the beginning of human life.
